name: catalog-card-consumers
goal: Catalog cards show at most three distinct consumers across module types while full usage remains on detail pages.

evidence: All shared card footers list at most the first three distinct consumers in existing module order. Detail relationship lists retain every consumer and their existing pagination.

The standardized grid matrix only enforces the helper-specific cap. Model assertions accept unlimited links, and component fixtures lack high fan-out. Extend shared footer unit cases and the existing grid matrix using mixed dense consumers.

At test commit 4c17b8a9b the unchanged standard grid matrix fails at desktop, tablet and mobile: model and component footers contain nine links against the three-consumer limit. Both shared-footer unit cases fail with six links instead of three.
Reuse the flat-footer limit API from main f65d56d45: ExplorerFunctionCard passes limit 3 for model rows. Existing helper and service caps and all detail relationships stay intact.
